2.0.0
- Free camera works in cutscenes (it now replaces the game's camera at the camera manager, so it works for
  every camera: soldier, vehicle, cutscene).
- F8: pause / resume the game and cutscenes without the pause menu (the game's own pause).
- Mouse look of the free camera; [camera] section in Noclip.ini (sensitivity, invert Y).
- Single-player gate: F6/F8 only work while the single-player local server is running.
- If a cutscene happened during the flight, the soldier is left where the game put it.
- Subtitles are hidden together with the HUD while the camera is on.

1.0.0
- Noclip flight (ghost mode: the soldier stays, the camera flies), HUD hiding, game input filter,
  safe landing, return to start (Backspace).
